eval_endpoint_error_sequence: compute endpoint error and temporal endpoint error metrics for predicted disparity sequences against ground truth
eval_batch: evaluate disparity prediction performance metrics for a batch including mean error and bad pixel percentages
depth_to_pcd: convert a depth map and image into a 3D point cloud with optional outlier filtering and extrinsic transforms

PerceptionMetric: create a frozen dataclass representing a perception metric name with optional depth scaling norm and suffix
